def check_core(cons: Sequence[LinCons], core: Sequence[int], max_constraints: int = 20000) -> bool:
    """Independently re-check an unsat core.

    The *proof checker*: it takes only the claimed core and re-derives
    unsatisfiability, sharing no state with the search that produced it. A
    certificate whose core fails this check is void (§12).

    This check has already earned its keep: it caught a namespace confusion
    between origin labels and row indices in the core extractor, on the first
    realistic example ever run through the system. That is the argument for
    proof-checking every proof, made by the code rather than by the prose.
    """
    subset = select_by_core(cons, core)
    if not subset:
        return False
    return not is_satisfiable(subset, max_constraints=max_constraints).sat
